description: Schema for a single Waze alert record. Each row in the output Parquet file conforms to this schema.

subtype.description: Alert sub type - depends on alert type parameter.

reportByMunicipalityUser.description: Whether the report was made by a municipality user.

reportRating.description: User rank between 1-6 (6 = high ranked user).

confidence.description: Confidence in the alert based on reactions of other users (e.g. thumbs up). Range: -1 to 5.

reliability.description: Confidence in the alert based on user input (e.g. thumbs up) and report rating. Range: 0-10.

street.description: Street name as written in database, no canonical form. May be null.

roadType.description: Road type code (see Waze road types table).

nThumbsUp.description: Number of thumbs up by users.

magvar.description: Alert direction (driver heading at report time). 0 = North, 89 = East, 179 = South, 269 = West. Range: 0-359.

city.description: City and state name [City, State] if both available, [State] if not associated with a city.

geometry.description: WKB-encoded point geometry of the alert.

time_retrieved.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was retrieved (UTC).
